title: A feedback flag on a fact added the day of its report stays after a later edit moves that fact
goal: feedback_flags drops a flag whose reported line did not exist at the start of the report's day once a later edit moves another fact onto that line; a report older than the article's first commit and a renamed article keep their flag while the fact still sits on the line. Found by the SP-vlfcgmbu review's second pass (gaps 1 and 3 on BG-w4ompvsk); an edit before the report on the same day still drops the flag, since the report's day carries no time (gap 2).
